maria-ramirez: Quick heads-up 10 AM PT 1: ACME POC ran far higher in dry-run than quoted (~1.2B tokens). Need a short-term bill protection plan so they don't get sticker shock and we don't throttle them mid-POC.

sam-deals: Do we have any levers? min-charge waive, credit, or temporary tiering?

maria-ramirez: Thinking: waive first-month min, create a one-off pilot credit (token-based), and apply a soft daily cap per API key with burst using the credit. Keep overage at normal hosted rates.

praveen-ops: We can enforce soft caps and alerting. How big is the credit you want?

maria-ramirez: Suggest 500k tokens credit (~$1.1k) + soft cap 200k/day per key, burst allowed to 500k/day using credit. Also want alerts to #sales and paging to @praveen-ops at 80% of soft cap.

sam-deals: I'll file to deal desk. Please paste an exact rule block to include.

maria-ramirez: Copyable snippet for deal desk: 

```
pilot_credit_tokens: 500000
waive_monthly_min: true
soft_cap_per_key_per_day: 200000
burst_allowed_up_to: 500000
overage_rate: hosted.standard_per_token
alerting: notify #sales + @praveen-ops at 80% threshold
```

leah-finance: Finance can approve a one-time 500k-token credit and waive the first-month minimum. Need PO number before applying credits and a credit memo in our ledger. Credits treated as contra-revenue and non-refundable; require MOU text for records.

jonathan-legal: I'll provide a short MOU blurb: "Pilot credits are a single, non-transferable concession applicable only to usage during the pilot period; they do not modify standard pricing or imply future discounts." Need account and dates to finalize.

sam-deals: Filing ticket now. Estimated cost on list rates: ~$1,100. Adding @leah-finance for sign-off.

billing-bot: Credit memo created: CM-2026-046 for 500k-token pilot credit on ACME-42, effective 2026-04-01.

praveen-ops: I'll configure the quota rules and alerting. ETA 3-5 hours. Will post deployed config.

maria-ramirez: Thanks all. Once PO arrives I'll confirm and close the ticket. :pray:
